notes.title: 🛠️ Graphical Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello bridge adventurers!

We’re excited to announce a major visual upgrade to Bridge Crossing! The world now looks sharper, richer, and more immersive than ever. Whether you're a seasoned crosser or just starting your journey, this update brings a fresh layer of depth to every step you take.

✨ What’s New?

Enhanced textures for environments and structures

More dynamic and realistic lighting

Refreshed visual effects for greater atmosphere

Sleek and modernized interface

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450997/06df7f0984af45f9b1eb5a007c58b83d30879c20.png"]

This graphical overhaul is designed to elevate your experience and make each crossing feel more alive. We’ve poured a lot of care into these improvements, and we can’t wait for you to see them in action.

🔧 Update now and enjoy the view!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450997/2fe21394f378aa2b548c7ea810c5060cdfe3669e.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450997/1669521f0dba6d2a3d1165884a8e2f205a0cf59c.png"]

Thanks for being part of the Bridge Crossing community. Your feedback keeps us moving forward — so keep it coming!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450997/fc0104dc85b6345dfd0a5fd851775eb5249ba0ef.png"]
